Comment: Stock Streaming Pipeline — Full Production Orchestrator (Project 05). Author: Janvi Chitroda. Checks infrastructure, runs all 4 medallion Glue jobs in parallel, refreshes the catalog with crawlers, validates data quality via Athena, and notifies on success or failure. AWS-native equivalent of the Dagster asset graph in Project 03. Orchestrates the PROCESSING layer only — Kinesis must exist and the producer must already be feeding it.

Author_Janvi_Chitroda.Comment: No-op marker state — shows authorship in the visual graph. Flows straight into CheckInfrastructure.

CheckInfrastructure.Comment: Fail fast: verify Kinesis is ACTIVE + S3 reachable BEFORE spending on Glue.

ProcessStreams.Comment: Fan out to all 4 Glue streaming jobs at once. glue:startJobRun.sync blocks each branch until its job ends, so this state finishes only when all 4 do.

RunCrawlers.Comment: Refresh the Glue Data Catalog (all 4 crawlers) so Athena/DQ see new data + partitions.

DataQualityChecks.Comment: Run 7 automated DQ checks via Athena — the Lambda raises if any violations, which routes here to NotifyFailure.

NotifySuccess.Comment: Everything passed — publish a success summary to SNS (same topic as the anomaly Lambda).

Parameters.Subject: ✅ Stock Pipeline — Complete Success
Parameters.Message:
Full pipeline execution completed successfully:

1. ✅ Infrastructure check passed
2. ✅ All 4 Glue jobs completed (Bronze, Silver 1min, Silver 5min, Gold)
3. ✅ All 4 crawlers updated the Data Catalog
4. ✅ All 7 DQ checks passed — zero violations

Query latest data in Athena (db = stock_streaming_db).

NotifyFailure.Comment: Any state's Catch lands here. States.Format injects the caught error ($.error) into the SNS message.

Parameters.Subject: ❌ Stock Pipeline FAILED
Parameters.Message.$:
States.Format('Pipeline failed at a step. Check CloudWatch logs for details.

Error: {}', $.error)
